text: When preparing a dish, onions and garlic are essential ingredients that bring a lot of flavor and aroma to the table. They are often used in sautéing or frying to add a savory flavor to dishes such as stir-fries, omelets, and casseroles. It is important to use them in moderation, as too much can overpower other flavors. To properly prepare onions and garlic, start by washing them thoroughly and trimming off any tough outer layers. Then, chop them into small pieces and sauté them in a pan with a small amount of oil until they are translucent. This can take anywhere from a few minutes to an hour, depending on the thickness of the onions and how you like them cooked. Once they are done, you can add them to your dish as desired, or use them to make a classic Greek salad or a delicious garlic roasted potato side dish. Remember, with a little bit of practice, you can master the art of cooking with onions and garlic and create a wide variety of delicious meals to enjoy!
